headline: Stlican Shelf Flares Anew as Callahan Front Endures Relentless Clashes
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, combat intensity has dramatically reignited across the Stlican Shelf, where ten base transfers erupted over the past two hours around Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost after a brief lull. Callahan’s Passage remains an inferno of shifting lines, recording another thirteen strategic base events in the same span as fighting swirls around The Latch, Crumbling Post, and The Crumbling Passage. Heavy attrition continues to rack the Weathered Expanse, where over nineteen hundred combined casualties fell in two hours alongside ongoing skirmishes near Frostmarch and Wightwalk. Further west, Fisherman’s Row maintains a muted pace with only three recent strategic shifts across its contested island outposts. Meanwhile, Mooring County and the Nevish Line persist as punishing attritional grinders, tallying substantial casualties without strategic territory trading hands in recent hours. With the eastern front reignited at Stlican Shelf and Callahan’s Passage locked in relentless turmoil, the central and northern theatres continue to drive the war’s heaviest engagements.
